{{Top|leg}}
The '''I2F-5''' series was the designation of [[Industrial droid/Legends|industrial droids]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in support of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. These droids were supported by a number of [[I2F-73]] transport units.
